info.title: strategist_bot research API
info.description: Run deterministic backtests through the trading engine: single runs with a full performance report (Sharpe, Sortino, drawdown, trade stats, VaR), Monte Carlo robustness analysis (bootstrap/permutation of trade PnLs), walk-forward analysis (in-sample grid optimization, out-of-sample validation), and parallel parameter sweeps. Execution costs (commission, taker slippage) are configurable per job. Jobs run in-process; poll until Completed or Failed.

post.summary:
Starts a backtest job. Provide exactly one data source: "dataFile"
(a market data CSV path on the server) or "generate" (synthetic data),
and at most one analysis mode: none (plain run with full performance
stats), "monteCarlo", "walkForward", or "sweep". Returns immediately
with the job id; poll GET /api/backtests/{id} until status is
Completed or Failed.

BacktestJobView.description: A backtest job as returned by the API.

dataFile.description: Path to a market data CSV to replay.

oneOf.description: Stored tick window to replay from QuestDB (alternative to DataFile).
Strategy to run; defaults to the built-in imbalanceQuoter.

priceScale.description:
Fixed-point price scale of the data (sim/synthetic 100, Alpaca 10000, cTrader 100000).
For QuestDB sources it also quantizes the stored venue doubles into engine prices.

oneOf.description: Run, then Monte Carlo the trade PnLs.
Walk-forward analysis instead of a single run.
Parameter grid sweep instead of a single run.

includeEquityCurve.description: Include the sampled equity curve in the result (plain run / Monte Carlo).

includeTrades.description: Include the FIFO round-trip list in the result (plain run / Monte Carlo).

BacktestRequest.description:
Request to start a backtest job. Provide exactly one data source:
string? BacktestRequest.DataFile (a market data CSV on the server's disk),
QuestDbSpec? BacktestRequest.QuestDb (ticks from the platform's QuestDB historical
store), or GenerateSpec? BacktestRequest.Generate (synthetic data produced in-process).

The analysis mode is picked by which (at most one) analysis spec is set:
none = plain run, MonteCarloSpec? BacktestRequest.MonteCarlo, WalkForwardSpec? BacktestRequest.WalkForward, or
SweepSpec? BacktestRequest.Sweep.

BacktestResultView.description: Union of the possible analysis outputs; exactly one section is populated.

commissionBps.description: Commission as basis points of fill notional.

takerSlippage.description: Price units added against marketable (taker) fills.

CostSpec.description: Execution cost assumptions, all in fixed-point engine units (default: frictionless).

instrumentId.description:
Registered instrument; its symbol is used when
    Symbol is omitted (needs the platform database).

symbol.description: Symbol to request from the source.

source.description:
History source tag (GET /api/history/sources);
    optional when exactly one is registered.

CreateHistoryFetchRequest.description: Queue a historical tick fetch into QuestDB (POST /api/history).

Distribution.description: Percentiles of a simulated distribution, in fixed-point cash units.

tsNanos.description: Timestamp of the record that produced the snapshot.

equity.description: Mark-to-market equity in fixed-point cash units (starts at 0).

position.description: Net position across all symbols (signed lots) at the snapshot.

EquityPoint.description: One mark-to-market snapshot: equity = cash flow + Σ position × mid.

symbol.description: Symbol name stamped on the generated records.

GridSpec.description: Parameter grid: cross product of thresholds × quantities (empty axis = base value).

probabilityOfLoss.description: Fraction of simulated paths ending with PnL < 0.

probabilityDrawdownExceedsOriginal.description: Fraction of paths whose drawdown exceeds the original backtest's max drawdown.

riskOfRuin.description: Fraction of paths that dip below -RuinEquity (0 when no ruin threshold given).

method.description: bootstrap (resample with replacement) | permutation (reshuffle the exact set).

ruinEquity.description: Report P(equity dips below -ruinEquity); 0 = off. Engine price units.

MonteCarloSpec.description: Monte Carlo analysis of the backtest's trade PnLs.

PerformanceStats.description:
Performance statistics computed from an equity curve and FIFO round trips.

The backtest has no initial capital — equity is cumulative PnL starting at
0 — so ratio metrics use per-bucket PnL deltas rather than percentage
returns. Sharpe/Sortino are annualized only when the data spans at least
one hour of real time (see bool PerformanceStats.Annualized); synthetic files with
event-counter timestamps get the raw per-bucket ratio instead of a
nonsense x10⁹ annualization.

symbol.description: Venue symbol the ticks are stored under (e.g. "US30", "BTC/USD").

venue.description: Optional venue tag filter ("ctrader" | "metatrader" | "alpaca"); omit to merge all venues.

QuestDbSpec.description:
A stored tick window in the platform's QuestDB historical store (the
shared `ticks` table the bot's /api/history fetch jobs populate).

direction.description: Direction of the opening leg (Buy = long trade).

pnl.description: Net PnL in fixed-point cash units (includes commission share).

RoundTrip.description:
A completed round trip produced by FIFO-matching fills per symbol.
PnL is net of the commission attributed to the matched quantity.

RunResultView.description: Statistics of a single replay (plain run and Monte Carlo modes).

RunSummary.description: Compact per-run summary used by sweeps and walk-forward windows.

model.description: Path to the .onnx model (required for kind "onnx").

threshold.description: Quoter entry / onnx P(up) entry threshold in bps (0 = strategy default).

qty.description: Order size in lots (0 = strategy default).

exitThreshold.description: Onnx P(up) exit threshold in bps (0 = strategy default).

maxHoldBars.description: Onnx maximum holding time in closed bars (0 = strategy default).

StrategySpec.description: Strategy configuration, mirroring the CLI options.

SweepResultView.description: Parameter sweep result: every cell plus the best one by the objective.

grid.description: The grid to search; must contain at least 2 cells.

SweepSpec.description: Parameter sweep configuration (in-sample grid search over the whole file).

walkForwardEfficiency.description: Mean per-window efficiency; > 0.5 is commonly read as "not curve-fit".

consistencyScore.description: Fraction of windows with positive OOS PnL.

trainBlocks.description: In-sample window size in blocks (block = total / (folds + trainBlocks)).

anchored.description: Expanding train window anchored at the start instead of rolling.

oneOf.description: In-sample optimization grid (omit for pure OOS validation of the base strategy).

efficiency.description: Chosen parameters' OOS PnL-per-record over IS PnL-per-record (1.0 = holds up perfectly).

WalkForwardWindow.description: One walk-forward window: optimize in-sample, validate out-of-sample.
